technique_name: Write a short letter from someone about the impact of the pandemic
description:
Dear Friends, 

The COVID-19 pandemic has been an incredibly difficult time for all of us. The unprecedented disruption to our lives has been difficult to cope with and has taken an emotional toll on many people. 

Every day, we hear stories of people struggling to make ends meet, of businesses forced to close, of heart-wrenching stories of tragedy and resilience. It has been a time of challenge and uncertainty, but there is also hope. We have seen remarkable acts of kindness, creative solutions
